name: FLORES-200
description: FLORES is a benchmark dataset for machine translation between English and low-resource languages. FLORES-200 doubles the existing language coverage of FLORES-101. The creation of FLORES-200 includes languages with less standardization and requires more specialized professional translations. FLORES-200 has several languages which were not translated from English. Specifically, several languages were translated from Spanish, French, Russian and Modern Standard Arabic. Moreover, FLORES-200 also includes two script alternatives for four languages. FLORES-200 consists of translations from 842 distinct web articles, totaling 3001 sentences. These sentences are divided into three splits: dev, devtest, and test (hidden). On average, sentences are approximately 21 words long.

rai:dataCollection: FLORES-200 consists of translations from 842 distinct web articles, totaling 3001 sentences. Several languages were translated from Spanish, French, Russian and Modern Standard Arabic rather than from English.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: 842 distinct web articles from Wikinews and other sources
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Professional translations were used to create the dataset. Given the nature of the new languages, which have less standardization and require more specialized professional translations, the verification process became more complex. This required modifications to the translation workflow.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for machine translation evaluation, specifically for the WMT2021 shared task on Large-Scale Multilingual Machine Translation. It serves as a benchmark dataset for machine translation between English and low-resource languages.
